quoted.text: JUST IN - A suspected supply chain attack on Optimizely loaded malware on Zoom, CNN, Fox News, BBC, Salesforce, GitLab, KLM, Air France, Bitly, IG Group, American Eagle and others, exposing visitors to scripts built to steal payment data and exploit iOS devices.
quoted.text_zh: 最新消息——一起针对 Optimizely 的疑似供应链攻击，在 Zoom、CNN、Fox News、BBC、Salesforce、GitLab、KLM、Air France、Bitly、IG Group、American Eagle 等网站上加载了恶意软件，使访问者暴露于用于窃取支付数据和利用 iOS 设备的脚本。

quoted.text:
DocuSign wants $8,100/yr from a 15-person team just to sign PDFs. So I built SignuDoc: open source, one-click deploy to your own @vercel account, $0 per seat.

White-label branding, full audit trails, tamper-evident seals and your documents never leave your cloud.
quoted.text_zh:
DocuSign 想向一个 15 人团队每年收 $8,100，就为了签个 PDF。所以我做了 SignuDoc：开源，一键部署到你自己的 @vercel 账号，每个席位 $0。

支持白标 branding、完整审计追踪、防篡改印章，而且你的文件不会离开你自己的云。
